ctx.x: Paul Crawford. Dick Allen. Okay. That makes it easier for the secretary. She knows which voice is which. Almond, let me see. First thing I'd like to start with is just about you, when you were born and where exactly.
Well Dick, I was born on Tulane Avenue, the exact address I don't know. I was born somewhere on Tulane. I was born December the 6th, 1910.
